title: Beats and note lengths
goal: Keep a steady beat and play notes that last one, two and four beats.

steps.title: The beat
steps.text: Music has a steady beat, like a clock or a heartbeat. We count it 1 2 3 4, 1 2 3 4. The next step clicks the beat for you.

steps.title: Play on the click
steps.text: Count 1 2 3 4 with the clicks, then play middle C on every click.

steps.title: Long and short notes
steps.text: A note can last 1 beat (a quarter note), 2 beats (a half note) or 4 beats (a whole note). You play it on its first beat and wait for the rest.

steps.title: Quarter notes
steps.text: One beat each. Play on every click: 1 2 3 4.

steps.title: Half notes
steps.text: Two beats each. Play on 1, hold and count 2, play on 3, hold and count 4.

steps.title: Whole notes
steps.text: Four beats each. Play on 1 and hold the key while you count 2 3 4.

steps.title: Check: keep the beat
steps.text: Four short notes, then two half notes, then a whole note.
